name: Resource Monitor
description: Draws live CPU, RAM and GPU graphs for the player on its own statistics page.
info:
Samples Luma CPU/RAM and the player's own GPU usage: per-process engine counters from `/proc/<pid>/fdinfo` on AMD/Intel, `nvidia-smi pmon` on NVIDIA. The system-wide GPU figure is only shown, labelled as such, when neither source is available.
Enable it and approve process access.
Open Statistics (I), then press 3 (or its assigned number).
Graphs cover the last ~2 minutes.
